en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing an arcaded walkway with vaulted ceilings along a town square. Sunlight creates strong contrasts of light and shadow, with a small child standing in a bright patch of light under one of the arches. To the left, beyond the arches, are cobblestone streets, historic multi‑story buildings, and several early‑ to mid‑20th‑century cars. Potted plants and a lantern hang from the arcade ceiling. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.
